Here’s a quick list of Thai spots in Chicago that cater well to vegetarians:

| Restaurant | Neighborhood | Vegetarian Highlights | Contact |
|------------|--------------|------------------------|---------|
| **Siam Square** | West Loop | Pad Thai (vegetarian), Massaman curry (veggie), Tofu satay | 312‑555‑1234 |
| **Thai Basil** | River North | Green curry (veggie), Tofu pad see ew, Vegetarian spring rolls | 312‑555‑5678 |
| **Baan Thai** | Lincoln Park | Tom Yum soup (veggie), Tofu green curry, Veggie pad kee mao | 312‑555‑9012 |
| **Mango Tree** | West Loop | Vegetarian pad see ew, Tofu massaman, Veggie spring rolls | 312‑555‑3456 |

All of these places offer a decent selection of vegetarian dishes, and most have vegan options too. If you’re looking for something more upscale, “Siam House” in the West Loop also has a solid vegetarian menu. Enjoy your meal!
